description: She wears an opaque burgundy floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice, elbow-length sleeves, wide gold woven borders at neckline/cuffs/central skirt panel, two round gold shoulder brooches, a jeweled belt clasp, a cream-and-gold shoulder wrap resting around her arms and bronze-gold closed shoes. No headgear, armor or weapon is visible.
